session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: Hey Bob! I finally adopted a cat named Whiskers.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: That's great! What color is Whiskers?

session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: She's orange and white. I got her from the shelter on 1st January.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: Nice, shelters need more adopters like you.

session_2.speaker: Alice
session_2.text: Really well! I started a new job as a baker this week too.

session_2.speaker: Bob
session_2.text: A baker, wow. What do you bake?

session_2.speaker: Alice
session_2.text: Mostly sourdough bread, it's my favorite thing to make.
